label: Law versus true accidental regularity: BestSystemReading identifies laws with theorems of a…
definition: BestSystemReading identifies laws with theorems of a selected system. Selection must independently earn truth, simplicity, strength and, for probabilistic systems, fit. The toy Regularity language distinguishes a pattern theorem from an incidental truth; it does not implement those standards, chances, or a full account of causation.
note: Explicit analytical interface for issue #270. Source support and its limits are separately recorded in the linked source claims and docs/hume-regularity.md. Stronger metaphysical identifications require further argument.
